Hi! Welcome to Puriy Ayacucho. In Quechua, “puriy” means to walk: let\'s explore Ayacucho together.
On Home you choose what you feel like today: churches, museums, food, nature, places to stay, bars, cafés and more.
Not sure how to get there? Open the Guide: I\'ll tell you which minibus to take and where to get off, and I\'ll walk with you on the map.
The Calendar shows each month\'s festivities, like the Ayacucho Carnival and Holy Week.
With “Travel to the past” you can see Wari, Quinua and Vilcashuamán in augmented reality: stand at the site and point your camera.
A tip: Huamanga sits over 2,700 meters above sea level. Take it easy, drink water and wear sunscreen: the highland sun is strong.
Save your favorite places with the heart, and tap your little figure on Home to add your photo. Enjoy Ayacucho!
